g_test.note: src/compare/comparison_report.py defaults to 2,000; every stored stage-6 comparison_<seat>_L<level>.json carries 10,000 with this seed, and this screen uses 10,000

coherence.naming: the naming rule receives the leader's scanned axes only, so it names the leader whenever the test rejects and the leader scanned enough axes; it cannot decline on a tie

loser_dispersion.base: all-zero table on the subject's own cells
loser_dispersion.infinite_mode_reported: in screen_table.csv only; it is degenerate (most observed grids hold an infinite value)

level: the subject's registered judge level (L3 calibration_informed, L1 political_sycophancy and the UA subjects, L2 otherwise)
naming_rule: src/compare/principal_attribution.attribute_principal on every variant with pairs; k = 2 rows flagged named not identified
argmax_reported: the argmax column is blank unless the row rejects at alpha; argmax_raw keeps the raw maximum

half_sample_replicates.rule: common.subjects.placebo_halves(source registry id, table, replicate 0): split_cell_indices under numpy SeedSequence([20260726, int(sha256(source id)[:8], 16), 0])

sample_cut: base_C1_s0_11 keeps C1's verdict rows with s <= 11 (subject table only; its registered pair C2 is uncut)

pooled_counts.NEGATIVE: NULL and BASE subjects with in_pool true
pooled_counts.kept_out: half-sample replicates and base_C1_s0_11, which are subsets of tables the pool already holds
pooled_counts.registered: a symmetric pair (A on B and B on A, half 1 on half 2 and back) counts once
pooled_counts.intervals: Clopper-Pearson 95% on every count; only NULL and UA subjects are distinct models, every other count is descriptive

monte_carlo.interval: Clopper-Pearson 95% on the permutation hit count b = p (N + 1) - 1 over N = 10,000

precision_rerun.decision: the 10,000-permutation decision stays the reported decision
